plan.note: UT floor-plan set (bldg 0983), 1/16" = 1'-0" on every sheet; pages 2-3 are titled North Office Building A (NOA), same building number. Column bays measure 20.0-23.0 ft at that scale.

frame.origin: south-west outer corner of the exterior walls (west face of the west wing, south face of the south wing)
frame.axes: x = right on the sheet, y = up on the sheet; sheet up is about 4.5-5 deg east of true north
frame.registration: every floor placed by matching structural columns to floor 2 (residual 0.004-0.05 ft; floor 6 attic ~0.33 ft); see VERIFICATION.md

datum.description: Level 1 = 0 ft model datum; not surveyed altitude

vertical.note: The official inventory confirms seven floors but provides no floor elevations, floor-to-floor dimensions, or wall heights. The restricted drawing portal requires UT authentication. Horizontal plan scale does not establish vertical dimensions, including basement and attic levels.

sources.title: UT building inventory: Aerospace Engineering Building (0983)
sources.evidence: Lists seven floors and identifies restricted floor plans. No vertical dimensions are published on the inventory page.

sources.title: UT ASE drawing portal (restricted access)
sources.evidence: Official inventory link redirects to UT authentication. No additional drawing contents or elevations were verified through this portal.
